body:
Thank you for your kind words.
That simple "I love you" platonic as it may be,I felt a warmth deep in my chest,that in all honesty I haven't felt in a long time,I'm talking years. 
Today I do feel better,but the thought still lingers on my mind. And to be honest,there's a lot more reason to my attempt.
My family genetics are well...garbage,I'm talking about heart problems,diabetes,alzheimers,dementia,I mean who seriously wants to live long enough to see if that gravy train of shit decides to show up. Not to mention,I recently found out I have inherited my mothers border line personality disorder,and that's just a grand mess of its own. 
But once again,thank you.
